answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 156651 Country: India Title: Can parents give all their properties to only one child of their 7 children? Question: Can parents give all their properties to only one child of their 7 children? Answer ID: 156651 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 351/241/SN=3/1439) It is mandatory to maintain equality and justice while gifting something among the children. It is unlawful and sin to give whole or most of the property to one child and deprive the others. But in case the father gives the whole property to one child and gives it into his complete possession and withdraws his discretion from it then this gift shall be effective and that child shall become its owner. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
